CharacterProfile.title: CharacterProfile
CharacterProfile.description: Stores a player's wizard character progression, unlocked Labyrinth stages (1-5), unlocked Diablo-style difficulties, inventory, spells, staffs, artifacts, and pet.

id.description: Unique character identifier matching document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the character owner.

name.description: Display name of the wizard character.

playerXp.description: Current XP toward next wizard level.

highestUnlockedStage.description: Highest unlocked Labyrinth stage on the active difficulty (1-5).

highestUnlockedDifficulty.description: Highest unlocked Diablo-style difficulty tier (1 = Normal, 2 = Nightmare).

unlockedStageD1.description: Highest unlocked Labyrinth stage on Difficulty 1 (1-5).

unlockedStageD2.description: Highest unlocked Labyrinth stage on Difficulty 2 (1-5).

equippedStaffId.description: Currently equipped staff or wand ID.

ownedArtifacts.description: List of owned artifact IDs including duplicates (bounded <= 60).

equippedArtifacts.description: Map of equipped artifact slots (robe, gloves, ring, boots) to artifact IDs.

spellLevels.description: Map of spellId to upgrade level (1-6).

reagentInventory.description: Map of reagentId to quantity owned.

tamedPetSpecies.description: Species ID of active tamed pet or 'none'.

tamedPetTrainingStep.description: Training step of active tamed pet (0-3).

tamedPetXp.description: Combat XP of active tamed pet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the character was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the character was last saved.

/users/{userId}/characters/{characterId}.description: Stores the authenticated user's wizard characters and progression.
